owner: Highscores module (persisted World snapshots of migration 0129, never live state)
offer_gate: HS-WIRE-1: offered in every offered set (production, Item view and bundle World). With it selected, command type 14 reads one 50-row page of the session's own World snapshot (categories 1 to 11, base-vocation filter 0 to 5) with the asking Character's own row, and never computes ranks. A category outside 1 to 11 is NOT_SUPPORTED and an echoed snapshot token that is no longer retained (current or previous) is SNAPSHOT_EXPIRED, both as FND-02 error results without rows. Without it selected, command type 14 is refused as an unregistered command.
